title: QA: the Ophan of Hours in the sky
eyebrow: QA for pull request 445, issue #418 · merged into staging, not main · manual co-op test still owed

short.lead: In the last minute of a raid the Ophan of Hours hangs in the sky with its wings spread, watches whoever carries the most, locks on, and drains them with a beam unless stone is between you.
short.hint: Tap an item to see what was checked and what you can try yourself.
items: It no longer floods your own view

On the target's own screen the beam fades out over its last 25 m and is 0.8 m wide at you, so you see the eye glow and your health drop, not a white wedge. The proof card "Visual: the beam's look" shows it.
A new held pose in the sky
ophan_spread holds after the arrival: 13.2 m wide by 7.8 m tall on the model (the old hover was 11.7 by 9.5). The proof card "Animation: wings-spread pose" plays it.
The host carried an artifact into the open: after the 3-second lock-on the piece was gone and the host stayed at 100 health. The proof card "Gameplay: the hunt" shows the recording slot.
Set out with a friend and stay until the last minute.
Tell me how the drone and shake feel.

wrapup.summary: The Ophan in the sky is built and passes every script check on its branch and on staging.
wrapup.changing: Every raid is hunted for now.
wrapup.blocking: #418 stays open until your QA pass.
wrapup.next: After you pass it, #419 branches off staging.
